company_name: Qingdao Goldliton Electronic Equipment Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and processes.
summary: Qingdao Goldliton Electronic Equipment Co., Ltd. is a technology-focused manufacturer of semiconductor equipment, particularly in thin film processing and crystal growth. They offer a range of systems including LPCVD, PECVD, and various vacuum furnaces, catering to the semiconductor industry's needs for advanced manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Crystal growth systems (VGF/VB, HGF/HB, HVPE, PVT)
Vacuum heat treatment furnaces (single and multi-chamber)

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Jiulong District, Qingdao, indicating a strong presence in the Chinese semiconductor equipment market.
